manifest.description.en: A professional Git workbench inside Visual Studio Code.
manifest.description.zh-CN: Visual Studio Code 中的专业 Git 工作台。

manifest.capabilities.untrustedWorkspace.en: Git execution requires a trusted workspace.
manifest.capabilities.untrustedWorkspace.zh-CN: Git 操作需要受信任的工作区。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Workbench language. Git operation names remain in English. The in-workbench language selector is remembered for this workspace.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: Workbench 显示语言。界面中的语言选择会为当前工作区保存。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Git executable path. Empty uses the built-in Git extension path or PATH.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: Git 可执行文件路径。留空时使用内置 Git 扩展的路径或 PATH。
每页历史记录加载的提交数。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Visible workbench refresh interval in seconds.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: 可见 Workbench 的刷新间隔（秒）。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Allow direct Detached HEAD Checkout. Disabled by default; create and switch to a local branch when inspecting historical versions.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: 允许直接切换到 Detached HEAD。默认关闭；查看历史版本时请创建并切换到本地分支。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Default to pushing missing annotated Tags reachable from the selected branch during Push. The Push dialog can override and remember this choice.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: 分支 Push 时默认同时推送该分支可达且远端缺少的注解标签。可在 Push 对话框中临时覆盖并记住选择。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Push a newly created Tag to the selected remote by default. The Create Tag dialog can override and remember this choice.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: 默认把新建标签推送到所选远端；创建标签对话框可以单次覆盖并记住该选择。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Default mode selected when opening Reset. The dialog can override and remember Soft, Mixed, or Hard.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: 打开重置对话框时默认选择的模式；可在对话框中覆盖并记住 Soft、Mixed 或 Hard。

manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.en: Workbench appearance, keyboard and reading preferences shared across windows.
manifest.contributes.configuration.prope.zh-CN: 跨窗口共享的工作台外观、快捷键与阅读偏好。

manifest.dockedModeDescription.en: Open in a movable view in a sidebar or the panel.
manifest.dockedModeDescription.zh-CN: 在可移到侧边栏或面板的视图中打开。

manifest.legacyOpenMode.en: Legacy opening mode. Used only until Workbench Locations is configured.
manifest.legacyOpenMode.zh-CN: 旧版打开方式，仅在尚未配置工作台显示位置时使用。

manifest.workbenchLocationsDescription.en: Available Workbench locations and the default destination of Open Workbench. Changing this setting preserves existing workbenches and drafts.
manifest.workbenchLocationsDescription.zh-CN: 可用工作台位置及 Open Workbench 默认入口。修改设置保留已有工作台与草稿。

manifest.enabledLocationsDescription.en: Select one or more locations. Disabling a location does not close a live Workbench.
manifest.enabledLocationsDescription.zh-CN: 选择一个或多个位置。取消勾选不会关闭正在使用的工作台。

manifest.defaultLocationDescription.en: Destination for Open Workbench. Must be one of the enabled locations.
manifest.defaultLocationDescription.zh-CN: Open Workbench 的打开位置，必须属于已启用的位置。

manifest.openInSidebar.zh-CN: 在主侧边栏打开工作台

manifest.copyToEditor.en: Copy Current State to a New Editor Tab
manifest.copyToEditor.zh-CN: 携带当前状态新建标签页

manifest.openInAuxiliary.zh-CN: 在第二侧边栏打开工作台
